lines.trans: Nina, did you come back to me?
You are still standing in the cold.
I promised that I would wait.
You are truly a completely incorrigible person.
So maybe after all it is yes?
Well alright, maybe it is yes!
Are you truly willing to become my wife?
Yes, I agree to marry you.
Then put on this ring quickly!
It really is very beautiful and shines.
Now we will go to the registry office together.
And submit our first joint application.
I promise to be the very best husband!

meanings.note: забрать заявление = to withdraw a statement

Written request. Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'явление'). Verbal action/result neuter noun formed with '-ение'/'-ание'. Common neuter noun meaning 'statement; application' in everyday Russian.

examples.text: Поговори с Аракеляном. Пусть он заберёт заявление.
examples.trans: Talk to Arakelyan. Get him to withdraw his statement.
